Application Developer - Security Engineering
## PRIMARY PURPOSE
Designs, develops, and maintains applications, integrations, and automation that support enterprise security operations. Partners with Security Operations, IAM, Cloud Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture to turn detection and response requirements into working software. Builds and tunes content within the organization’s SIEM platform, develops data pipelines that feed it, and automates response workflows. Applies secure-by-default engineering practices, least privilege, and documented change control to everything delivered.
## Essential Functions and Responsibilities
## Application development
• Develops, tests, and maintains applications, APIs, and services supporting security operations and compliance reporting.
• Writes code that follows secure development standards, including input validation, output encoding, secrets management through an approved vault, and dependency scanning in the build pipeline.
• Participates in peer code review, maintains unit and integration test coverage, and supports CI/CD pipelines for application and detection content releases.
• Produces and maintains technical documentation, including design decisions, data flows, interface contracts, and runbooks with named ownership.
## SIEM engineering and detection content
• Builds, tests, and tunes SIEM detection rules, correlation searches, dashboards, and scheduled reports.
• Develops and maintains log ingestion pipelines: source onboarding, parsing, field extraction, normalization to a common schema, and enrichment.
• Troubleshoots ingestion gaps, parsing failures, licensing and volume issues, and data quality problems affecting detection reliability.
• Manages detection content as code in version control, with documented test cases, promotion through non-production environments, and rollback procedures.
• Maps detection coverage to a recognized framework such as MITRE ATT&CK and reports coverage gaps to Security leadership.
## Automation and integration
• Develops integrations between the SIEM and adjacent platforms, including EDR, identity, ticketing, vulnerability management, and cloud-native security services.
• Builds SOAR playbooks and automation scripts that reduce manual analyst effort, with approval gates on any action that is destructive or privileged.
• Instruments applications and infrastructure for security-relevant logging and validates that required audit events reach the SIEM.
## Governance and collaboration
• Works with Security, Cloud Engineering, IAM, and application teams to gather requirements and validate that delivered tooling meets operational need.
• Supports audit and compliance evidence requests related to logging, monitoring, and alerting controls.
• Follows enterprise change management for all production changes, including approvals, testing evidence, and defined back-out plans.
• Participates in an on-call or escalation rotation for critical security tooling.
## Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and experience considered.
• Four or more years of professional software development experience.
• Two or more years working directly with a SIEM platform, Google Security Operations (Google SecOps) preferred; comparable experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic Security, or IBM QRadar considered.
• Proficiency writing SIEM query and detection logic — for example YARA-L 2.0 in Google SecOps, or KQL, SPL, or an equivalent query language — including performance tuning of scheduled rules and searches.
• Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, C#/.NET, Java, or Go, plus scripting with PowerShell or Bash.
• Working knowledge of REST API development and consumption, JSON, authentication patterns including OAuth 2.0, and webhook-based integration.
• Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines.
• Practical understanding of core security concepts: authentication and authorization, encryption in transit and at-rest, logging and audit requirements, least privilege, and common attack techniques.
• Demonstrated ability to document assumptions, dependencies, and operational ownership for delivered work.
## Preferred qualifications
• Hands-on Google SecOps engineering experience, including UDM (Unified Data Model) normalization, parser and parser-extension development, log forwarder and ingestion API onboarding, data RBAC, reference lists, and Applied Threat Intelligence or curated detection content.
• Experience with log pipeline and routing tools such as Cribl, Logstash, Fluent Bit, or Kafka.
• Detection-as-code practices, including Sigma rules, automated detection testing, and content promotion pipelines.
• SOAR development experience, Google SecOps SOAR (formerly Siemplify) preferred; Microsoft Sentinel playbooks, Splunk SOAR, or Cortex XSOAR also considered. Includes playbook design, custom integration and action development in Python, and case management workflow configuration.
• Cloud security engineering in Azure or AWS, including native logging services, managed identities, and private networking patterns; working familiarity with Google Cloud a plus given the SecOps platform.
• Infrastructure as code with Terraform or Bicep.
• Experience supporting regulated data environments and control frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOX, or NIST CSF.
• Relevant certifications, for example Google Cloud Professional Security Engineer, Google SecOps platform training or credentials, Microsoft SC-200, GIAC GCDA or GCIA, CompTIA Security+, or CISSP.
• Experience with containerized workloads and Kubernetes.
## Core Competencies
• Translates security requirements into maintainable software rather than one-off scripts.
• Communicates technical risk clearly to operations, engineering, and non-technical stakeholders.
• Exercises judgment about blast radius before acting on production systems.
• Works effectively across security, infrastructure, and application teams with competing priorities.
• Maintains confidentiality when handling sensitive security, customer, or employee data.

title: Game Developer
description:
Role Title: Game Developer
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Game Developers to contribute to a pioneering customer project focused on evaluating and advancing AI capabilities in the domain of game creation and interaction. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Leverage your hands-on experience to build authentic debugging and feature challenges within real game projects, directly impacting how AI agents learn to analyze, play, and develop games. Developers from all backgrounds—whether from AAA studios, indie circles, or solo projects—are encouraged to participate.
## Scope of Work
• Design and build small-scale game projects or interactive scenes in a major game engine to serve as the foundation for assessment tasks.
• Integrate realistic gameplay bugs that require thorough playtesting and on-screen analysis to discover and resolve.
• Develop multifaceted gameplay feature challenges that rely on multiple in-game systems and mechanics.
• Draft clear and concise briefs for each task, emulating the style of instructions from players, designers, or producers.
• Create comprehensive reference solutions—including both bug fixes and feature implementations—for every assignment.
• Define detailed success criteria, including input sequences, expected visual outcomes, and verifiable in-game states.
• Conduct end-to-end playtesting of each task to guarantee reliability and solvability.
## Preferred Qualifications
• Demonstrated experience in game development, whether in AAA, indie, solo, or serious hobby contexts.
• A portfolio or verifiable published work (personal site, itch.io, Steam, GitHub, game jam entries, or shipped title credits). Your portfolio is the most important part of your application and plays a major role in our selection, so please include the work that best represents your skills.
• Advanced proficiency with at least one major game engine (Unity, Godot, Unreal), including editor tools, scene management, and debugging utilities.
• Comfort with engine scripting languages such as C#, GDScript, C++, or Blueprints, with the ability to interpret, troubleshoot, and enhance gameplay logic.
• Proven ability to identify and resolve gameplay issues through iterative playtesting.
• Strong written communication skills for drafting precise task instructions and acceptance criteria.
• Experience in game QA, technical design, systems design, automated testing, or prior contribution to AI evaluation projects is a plus.
## Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

title: Data Engineer, AI & Analytics
description:
## Who We Are:
We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.
As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.
At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.
Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.
***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.
## A day in the life:
You'll sit on the Data Team, which owns the core data foundation for Power Digital: the pipelines, modeling, and data marts that power our agency teams, clients, and AI initiatives. You'll work end to end, from raw ingestion through the semantic layer, using AI-agentic workflows as a normal part of how you build.
The data itself is the interesting part. Marketing data is fragmented by default. Every ad platform has its own API, its own schema, and its own definition of a conversion. Platforms restate attributed conversions days after the fact, each in a different way. Entity hierarchies don't match (campaign/ad set/ad on Meta, campaign/ad group/ad on Google). Naming conventions, currencies, and timezones vary by client.
We do this across a large client portfolio, each client with a different stack, in a warehouse with per-client tenancy. You'll work closely with Client Service, BI, Tagging & Tracking, Data Ops, and the nova product/engineering teams.
## Key Responsibilities:
• Design, build, and maintain the core data foundation (ingestion, modeling, and data marts), owning the workflow from raw platform data through the serving layers that support agency, client, internal, and AI consumers.
• Build ingestion that handles what ad platforms actually do: API changes, deprecated fields, aggressive rate limits, and retroactive restatement of conversion data, all without corrupting downstream models.
• Model across sources so the numbers reconcile: spend, impressions, conversions, and revenue across Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon, LinkedIn, and Microsoft, plus customer-level joins across Shopify, Klaviyo, GA4, and client CRMs.
• Contribute to client-bespoke modeling on top of the core layer: custom logic, overrides, and client-specific marts built in response to individual client requests, with patterns that extend the shared foundation rather than fork it. This is steady, recurring work, not an occasional exception.
• Build the semantic layers and metric definitions that let AI-generated SQL return consistent, correct answers.
• Use AI-agentic workflows, including AI coding tools, to accelerate development and build intelligent data infrastructure. Document what works so it becomes a standard team pattern.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with nova (product and engineering), AI/innovation, and client teams to translate requirements into data solutions and support rapid iteration on new products and features.
• Monitor and resolve data quality issues, and optimize pipelines for cost and performance across a multi-client warehouse.
## Role Requirements:
• 3+ years in data or analytics engineering, including 1+ years owning a dbt project of meaningful size in production, not just contributing models to one.
• Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with a focus on production-grade code for data pipelines and modeling.
• Deep expertise in dbt, not just writing models. Incremental strategies and full-refresh tradeoffs, Jinja and macros, packages, generic and singular tests, snapshots, source freshness, exposures, and how to keep a large project's DAG and materializations under control.
• Strong command of Snowflake and the surrounding cloud data stack to operate autonomously as a foundational data owner.
• Experience modeling in a multi-tenant environment, with the judgment to know when a client request belongs in a client layer and when it belongs in the core.
• Working knowledge of marketing and advertising datasets. You've handled UTMs, attribution windows, and the gap between platform-reported and warehouse-reported conversions.
• Proven experience designing and managing end-to-end data lifecycles from ingestion to serving, with reliability that holds for both BI and AI applications.
• Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure (GCP) and infrastructure-as-code principles.
• Real adoption of AI-agentic development workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) for coding, debugging, and system architecture.
• Demonstrated ability to architect AI-ready data models (feature stores, clean semantic layers) that support downstream initiatives.
• Experience with Git and CI/CD best practices, including automated testing you trust.
• Comfortable shipping iteratively and refining data products based on live feedback.
## Helpful but not required
• Agency, consultancy, or services experience. Working across many clients with different stacks transfers directly.
• Measurement work: incrementality, media mix modeling, attribution.
• Server-side tagging, or retail and marketplace data.
## You might be a fit if…
• You're a data engineer at a brand or retailer and want to work closer to the decisions your data drives.
• You've built marketing pipelines at an agency or martech company and know how they break.
• You're an analytics engineer who wants to own the full system rather than just the modeling layer.
• You've rebuilt your own workflow around AI coding agents and want that to be the job.
## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• AI-accelerated development. Reduce median development time from approved requirements to production deployment for new data pipeline and modeling requests by 20% within the first 6 months, using the team's established baseline for comparable requests. Document and productionize at least 1 reusable AI-agentic development pattern within the first 90 days and at least 2 within the first 12 months, with each pattern adopted in at least 2 production workflows or projects.
• Data quality and reliability. Maintain ≥99% accuracy and completeness across fields designated as critical for client-facing and AI-facing data products, measured through automated data quality tests and reconciliations. Maintain a ≥95% successful scheduled pipeline execution rate for owned production pipelines, excluding documented upstream vendor/platform outages.
• Client request throughput. Deliver ≥90% of assigned client-bespoke modeling requests within the agreed-upon turnaround time, measured quarterly. Where a bespoke request introduces logic applicable across clients, evaluate and document whether it belongs in the shared core or client-specific layer for 100% of material modeling changes.
• Cross-functional enablement. Launch or materially migrate at least 2 major production data assets within the first 12 months that support agency, client, product, or AI consumers. Within 90 days of each launch, demonstrate adoption through at least 2 active downstream consumers, applications, or teams per asset and achieve either a 20% reduction in related recurring data-support tickets or another pre-defined adoption/efficiency target agreed upon before launch.
## Most Important Things (MITs)
• Build and ship end-to-end data systems that enable AI features.
• Deliver production-ready datasets and pipelines that unblock AI, product, and client teams.
• Reduce fragmentation by building unified, AI-ready data foundations

title: Node.JS Developer
description:
En tant que Développeur Node.js, vous serez chargé(e) de concevoir, développer et maintenir des applications backend robustes et performantes en utilisant Node.js. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le cycle de développement, de la conception initiale à la mise en production, tout en assurant l’intégration avec des systèmes frontend et d’autres services tiers.

• Concevoir et développer des API RESTful et des services backend scalables avec Node.js.
• Assurer la qualité du code en appliquant les bonnes pratiques (tests unitaires, intégration continue, documentation).
• Intégrer et optimiser les bases de données (SQL et NoSQL) pour des performances optimales.
• Collaborer avec les équipes frontend pour garantir une intégration fluide entre les interfaces utilisateur et le backend.
• Participer à l’analyse des besoins techniques et fonctionnels pour proposer des solutions adaptées.
• Identifier et résoudre les problèmes de performance, de sécurité et de compatibilité.
• Suivre les dernières tendances et évolutions technologiques pour enrichir les projets et processus.

• Solide expérience en développement backend avec Node.js (au moins 2-3 ans).
• Maîtrise des frameworks Node.js tels qu’Express ou Nest.js.
• Connaissance approfondie des bases de données relationnelles (MySQL, PostgreSQL) et NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
• Expérience avec les API RESTful, JSON et WebSockets.
• Bonne compréhension des principes de développement sécurisé et des outils de gestion des authentifications (OAuth, JWT).
• Familiarité avec les outils et workflows DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
• Compétence en versionnement de code (Git).
## Profil recherché :
• Diplôme Bac+5 en informatique, génie logiciel ou un domaine connexe.
• Capacité à travailler en équipe tout en étant autonome et proactif.
• Bonnes aptitudes à résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes.
• Une expérience dans un environnement Agile/Scrum est un plus.

In this role, you will translate complex business challenges into practical, production-ready Applied AI solutions that deliver measurable value for our clients. You will collaborate closely with client stakeholders, senior architects, and cross-functional delivery teams to design and guide implementation of robust AI systems. You will help move AI initiatives from experimentation to production while ensuring reliability, scalability, governance, and responsible AI adoption.
## Key Responsibilities
• Lead the design of end-to-end Applied AI architectures that span predictive ML, MLOps, generative AI, LLM applications, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation aligned to client objectives and constraints.

You are a technically rigorous, client-focused problem solver who enjoys working in a fast-paced, outcomes-driven environment. You are comfortable operating in distributed, global teams and partnering with colleagues across time zones.

## Experience

title: AI Safety Argumentation Platform Research Engineer
description:
The case that AGI and ASI pose catastrophic risks is strong but poorly systematized: fragmented across literatures, inconsistently formalized, and vulnerable to motivated dismissal. CARMA is building an evidentiary infrastructure to fix this. It combines ontologies, knowledge graphs, defeasible argumentation frameworks, and LLM-assisted population pipelines under expert curation, feeding structured argument content into communications flows that reach policymakers, technical audiences, journalists, and the public.
In this role, you'll develop and operate that system. You'll work where argumentation theory meets agentic AI tooling, building machinery that is both formally tractable and persuasive in practice, the epistemic backbone that will help stakeholders elucidate why good arguments for prospective expectations are good, and why bad arguments are bad.
This position is 100% remote but requires occasional travel.
## About CARMA
The Center for AI Risk Management & Alignment (CARMA) works to help society navigate the complex and potentially catastrophic risks arising from increasingly powerful AI systems. Our mission is specifically to lower the risks to humanity and the biosphere from transformative AI.
We focus on grounding AI risk management in rigorous analysis, developing policy frameworks that squarely address AGI, advancing technical safety approaches, and fostering global perspectives on durable safety. Through these complementary approaches, CARMA aims to provide critical support to society for managing the outsized risks from advanced AI before they materialize.
CARMA is a fiscally-sponsored project of Social & Environmental Entrepreneurs, Inc., a 501(c)(3) nonprofit public benefit corporation.
## Responsibilities
• Extend ontologies and knowledge graph schemas representing claims, evidence, argument structures, defeaters, and confidence
• Implement defeasible argumentation frameworks (e.g., ASPIC+, Dung-style, argumentation schemes) that capture both logical structure and vulnerability to rebuttal
• Operate and quality-control LLM-driven population pipelines, with cross-check scaffolds, provenance tracking, and human-in-the-loop curation
• Architect agent coordination patterns for multi-step research and population tasks, with robust error handling and graceful degradation
• Pre-harden argument structures by mapping the strongest counterarguments, steel-manned objections, and known defeaters
• Build export pipelines that translate structured argumentation into diverse communications formats across audiences and registers
• Maintain current awareness across AI safety, capabilities, and governance sufficient to know when new developments require graph updates, and to know where to find authoritative further detail
• Collaborate with communications staff and researchers to ensure outputs serve real persuasive needs
## Required Qualifications
• Working familiarity with formal or semi-formal argumentation theory (abstract or structured argumentation, defeasible reasoning, dialectical models, or argumentation schemes)
• Experience with ontology engineering or knowledge graph development (OWL/RDF, property graphs, or equivalent)
• Operational experience with LLM agent systems: agent coordination platforms, prompt engineering at scale, and QC regimes for LLM outputs (adversarial probing, consistency checks, calibration)
• Fluent vibecoding practice: rapid prototyping and shipping with LLM-assisted development in production-adjacent contexts
• Substantive grounding in AI safety, AI governance, and current frontier-AI dynamics, with the literacy to locate authoritative sources on any sub-topic or human expertise in the space
• Familiarity with philosophy of science concepts bearing on evidence: defeaters, burden of proof, inference to the best explanation, underdetermination
• Good coding skills; comfort with graph databases or query languages
• Experience designing cross-check and verification scaffolds for unreliable automated processes
• Sound judgment about when a claim is well-supported versus when it needs hedging, further substantiation, or withdrawal
• Self-directed; strong written communication
## Preferred Qualifications
• Graduate work or equivalent depth in argumentation theory, computational argumentation, epistemology, or philosophy of science
• Familiarity with AIF, Carneades, or comparable computational argumentation tools
• Track record in AI safety or governance (publications, policy work, or substantive community contributions)
• Background in argument mining, claim extraction, or stance detection
• Experience with debate formats or structured deliberation methods
• Understanding of motivated reasoning, belief change, and cognitive biases as they bear on communications strategy
• Open-source contributions in any relevant area

description:
About Our Company:
Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Cologix is a leading North America network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company. Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. Backed by one of the largest North American infrastructure funds, Cologix's experienced leadership team, certified staff and commitment to ESG initiatives help form a culture that values our people, our environment and our clients.
About the Position:
Cologix is looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Systems Administration team. This role will be responsible for development and engineering of internal solutions that support the core business operation. Primary functions will be designing, deploying and monitoring automation services between various business systems; reviewing, analyzing and streamlining current business processes and systems; assisting with designing, deploying and management of core business systems.
## What you do daily:
• Contribute to the implementation of new products while supporting the ongoing development, maintenance, and optimization of DevOps practices across Engineering.
• Collaborate with vendors, engineering teams, and peer operations organizations to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.
• Develop and establish organizational standards, policies, procedures, and best practices for DevOps environments.
• Design and implement simple, repeatable, and reliable solutions that streamline systems, processes, and operational workflows.
• Own and coordinate release management activities to support consistent, controlled, and successful deployments.
• Establish, maintain, and support systems and tools used across development and production environments.
• Develop, administer, and maintain version control systems and associated processes.
• Maintain a comprehensive documentation library for DevOps systems, processes, and procedures.
• Create technical and operational documentation for new systems and solutions to enable effective transition and knowledge transfer to operational support teams.
## What makes you a good fit: (Qualifications)
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical discipline (preference), or equivalent professional experience.
• 3+ years of experience in DevOps
• 3+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, or a related role.
• Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix system administration and networking fundamentals.
• Experience with automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible or equivalent technologies.
• Experience working with a variety of open-source technologies and cloud platforms.
• Working knowledge of Apache, Tomcat, MySQL, and JVM-based server environments.
• Familiarity with scripting and programming languages such as Python, PHP, Perl, and/or Ruby.
• Strong understanding of IT operations best practices within highly available, production-critical environments.
• Ability to work independently, effectively manage priorities, and take ownership of assigned projects and tasks.
• Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and operational teams.
• A proactive, positive approach with a strong willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously develop new skills.
• AWS architecture certification, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, is a plus.
***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or transfer sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***
## Compensation
Benefits:
We offer a competitive benefit package for full-time employees that includes:
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Company paid Life Insurance
Voluntary supplemental life insurance
Flexible spending account
Health savings account
Non-accrued PTO
Short- and Long-Term Disability
Company paid holidays
401k Retirement Plan with employer match
Mental Wellness Benefits
Tuition Reimbursement
Paid Parental Leave
Employee Discount Marketplace
Employee Recognition Platform
Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience. This position will also be eligible for an annual bonus.
## Additional Information
NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as assigned to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.
Cologix is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status. If you need assistance in applying for any of our open positions, please contact us at recruiting@cologix.com or call 720-940-2551.
The California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) creates privacy rights relating to the collection, sale, disclosure, and deletion of consumers’ personal information. The CCPA requires businesses to provide consumers, including job applicants and employees, with information about their rights, including a description of the categories of personal information to be collected and the purpose for which the information will be used. For additional information regarding your rights, including a description of the categories of personal information to be collected and the purpose for which the information will be used, please see https://cologix.com/privacy-policy/.
Cologix’ data centers are ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 14001:2015 certified. These certifications demonstrate Cologix’s commitment to both information security and environmental stewardship. At Cologix, protecting information assets and minimizing environmental impacts are everyone’s responsibility.
Cologix employees are responsible for:
• Understanding and following Cologix’s information security, cybersecurity, privacy,
and environmental management policies, procedures, and standards.
• Ensuring conformance with the requirements of both the Information Security
Management System (ISMS) and the Environmental Management System (EMS).
• Remaining vigilant and reporting any information security or environmental incidents,
vulnerabilities, risks, or non-conformities to the appropriate teams.
• Actively participating in Cologix’s efforts to maintain and improve information security
and environmental performance.

title: Data Engineering Intern
description:
About Wurl, LLC.
At Wurl, our mission is to create innovative technologies and services that help accelerate the shift to streaming. At our core, we are innovators focused on driving the streaming industry forward with technologies that help connect viewers to the right content and ads. Our technology and data-driven solutions help companies reach new audiences, engage high-value viewers, and ultimately increase their revenue.
In 2022, Wurl was acquired by AppLovin (Nasdaq: APP), a leading marketing platform, giving our employees the best of both worlds: the dynamic environment of a 150+ person startup as well as the stability of a high-growth public tech company. We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024.
We’re looking for a Data Engineering Intern to assist in enhancing the quality and reliability of our data collection platform. This role will provide hands-on experience in data engineering, security operations, and cloud infrastructure, with guidance from experienced engineers and cross-functional teams.
## What You’ll Do
• Review and validate ETL processes for completeness and data consistency.
• Improve our data-consistency validation processes by migrating legacy and semi-manual validation processes to our new framework.
• Assist in developing monitoring and alerting systems for data consistency and configuration integrity.
• Work with the data team to analyze, streamline, automate, and improve ETL processes, including ingestion of new data sources. In particular, you’ll focus on improving the automation of our data-related channel-launch processes.
• Contribute to internal documentation and knowledge bases related to ETL, validation, and alerting procedures.
• Learn about and contribute to large-scale, cloud-native data systems.
## What You Bring
• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field. GPA of 3.5 or more
• Familiarity with SQL and Python.
• Understanding of basic cloud concepts (AWS preferred).
• Proven experience with industry-grade database solutions and with AWS (1+ years)
• Experience with ETL creation
• Agentic experience when it comes to the above
• 1+ years of relevant past internships
• Strong interest in data analysis and automation..
• Eagerness to learn and contribute to a fast-paced, remote engineering team.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Availability of at least 20 hours per week for at least 6 months
## Location
• US/CA Remote
## What We Offer
• Paid internship with flexible scheduling.
• Remote-first work culture and support.
• Hands-on mentorship from senior engineers.
AppLovin is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about EEO rights as an applicant here.
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please send us a request at jobs@applovin.com
AppLovin will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. If you’re applying for a position in California, learn more here.
Please read our Global Applicant Privacy Notice to learn more about how AppLovin processes your personal information.

title: Product Engineer - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
## The Role
We are looking for product engineer to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.
This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
## What You'll Own
Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.
Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.
Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.
Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.
Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.
Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.
Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.
## What We're Looking For
Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.
Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.
Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.
Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.
Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.
High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.
Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.
## The Kind of Builder We Want
Starts from user problems, not feature lists.
Can make decisions with incomplete information.
Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.
Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.
Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.
## This Role Is Not For
People who only write decks and do not drive execution.
PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.
Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.
People who launch features and then stop caring.
PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.
## Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria.
## Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
## Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role-specific interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: AI Engineer
description:
AI Engineer
Who we are
Makai Labs builds software that automates entire companies. We work across a diversified portfolio, which means our systems touch a wide range of domains, processes, and operational constraints. Our engineering team is small, senior, and high-output. We move fast, hold high standards, and trust each other to take ownership without being managed.
What we're looking for
Makai Labs is hiring a AI Engineer to help build AI systems for enterprise automation. This is a hands-on builder role where you’ll work closely with our engineering and design teams to prototype, ship, and improve AI-powered products and internal tools. You’ll have the opportunity to own smaller projects end to end while contributing to larger client and platform initiatives.
Responsibilities will include
Build and improve AI-powered applications and internal tools
Rapidly prototype, experiment, and iterate across client and internal projects
Implement workflows that use LLMs, retrieval systems, agents, and structured outputs
Contribute to shared platform work and reusable tooling
Turn prototypes into reliable, client-ready systems
Conduct research, benchmarking, testing, and evaluation of new approaches
Own smaller projects or sub-projects with guidance from the team
Take ownership of deliverables and help deliver work that meets client needs
Write and maintain clear internal documentation
Ideal Experience
Senior in college, recent graduate, or early-career engineer
Background in computer science (bonus if you also have business exposure)
Experience building AI applications through internships, coursework, research, or personal projects
Experience running AI experiments and iterating quickly
Strong Python skills
What we value
Initiative and willingness to learn quickly on the job
Bias toward action and comfort with fast iteration
Interest in staying current with AI advancements and applying them in practical systems
Wants to solve hard problems
Nice To Haves
Experience with APIs, backend services, or workflow automation
Familiarity with FastAPI, Flask, or similar backend frameworks
Familiarity with React and TypeScript
Familiarity with Docker and local development environments
Familiarity with testing in Python or TypeScript
Experience working with retrieval systems, embeddings, or search
Experience working with OCR, document processing, or PDF workflows
Experience with fine-tuning, benchmarking, or serving LLMs
Experience in fast-paced, high-accountability team settings
Core values for Makai employees
Have a strong work ethic
Be self-sufficient and self-driven with an ownership mentality, no matter your role
Be a flexible thinker
Be congenial and a team player
Always be of service to each other and our clients, partners, and neighbors
Benefits
Fully remote role, Eastern time zone
Opportunities to work in-person with local colleagues
Generous PTO
Full health insurance premium reimbursement
401(k) matching
Career growth & development opportunities

title: Software Engineer, Security, Stablecoin
description:
## About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.
## About the Role
Ramp is, at its core, a fintech company. Our financial infrastructure enables us to issue cards, move money globally, and manage treasury flows for our customers. Stablecoins are emerging as a critical lever to make these flows faster, cheaper, and more accessible.
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our engineering team with a dedicated focus on stablecoin-based payment and treasury systems. In this role, you will act as both a technical owner and multiplier: working on core stablecoin services, ensuring secure and reliable integrations with external partners, and guiding Ramp’s evolution toward next-generation fintech solutions.
Our ideal candidate combines deep curiosity about eventually consistent distributed systems with strong financial infrastructure experience, thrives in highly regulated and mission-critical environments, and has a passion for diving into new problem spaces.
## What You'll Do
Help build & scale Ramp’s stablecoin-based payment and treasury infrastructure
Partner with external providers and internal stakeholders to deliver end-to-end product flows
Solve Ramp’s toughest fintech challenges with new technologies
Collaborate with engineers across Ramp to integrate stablecoin capabilities into core products
## What You Need
Minimum 5+ years of experience shipping high-quality architectures for critical systems preferred
Proven experience with stablecoin technologies, blockchain-based payment rails, and/or wallet infrastructure
Strong production experience with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or equivalent)
Deep proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (Python, Go, Java, or similar)
Experience working on security-sensitive systems, with interest in key management, wallet security, or secure transaction flows.
Experience building or operating payments, money movement, treasury, stablecoin, or crypto infrastructure in production environments
## Nice to Have
Intuition for on-chain UX and settlement mechanics, including wallet-based transaction signing, confirmation/finality, and chain-level tradeoffs like fees and latency.
Direct experience building on-chain wallets or with integrating a crypto onramp / offramp APIs for custody and remittance flows
Experience integrating with external financial service providers and APIs at scale
Familiarity with cross-border settlement, FX, or treasury management systems
Background in highly regulated fintech environments (e.g., payments, banking, or government-compliant infrastructure)
## Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)
Flexible PTO
Centralized home-office equipment ordering
Health and wellness stipend
Budget for intra-office travel
Weekly coffee stipend
## United States
100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
One Medical annual membership
401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
Pet insurance
In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
## Canada
Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
Life, AD&D, and disability coverage
Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)
Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
description:
## Founding Full-Stack Engineer
Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.
## The opportunity
Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.
We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.
## About us
planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.
## What you'll own
The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.
Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.
Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.
Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.
Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.
The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.
You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.
## How we build
Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.
We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.
We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.
There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.
## What you'll bring
Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries.
Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable.
Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces.
Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together.
Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services.
Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.
Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.
Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP.
## What you'll get
Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.
A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team.
A real problem worth solving.
We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with.
Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.
Competitive pay + VSOP.
## The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)
Send your CV.
Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.
Meet our CEO and selected investors.
More at home in C++, algorithms, and optimization? Check out our Founding Optimization Engineer role.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.
Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.
Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.
## Develop MCP-Based Integrations
Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.
Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.
Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.
## Integrate Enterprise Systems

Microsoft Dynamics 365
Microsoft Graph
Dataverse
ServiceNow
Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms
Internal and third-party APIs
## Design Context, Memory & Intelligence
Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.
Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.
Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.
## Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem
Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.
Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.
Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.
## What You'll Bring
Microsoft Technology Expertise
Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.
Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:
Azure Functions
Azure App Service

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (x/f/m)
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ THE ENGINEERING TEAM ⭐ 

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL.

Want to know more? Read this article https://blog.alan.com/tech-et-produit/engineering-organisation-at-alan if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article https://medium.com/alan/engineering-career-path-at-alan-e5de5c2e740c on our Engineering career path.




WHICH AREA WILL  YOU JOIN ? 

By applying to this role, you’ll be considered for three different areas. Throughout the hiring process, we’ll discuss your experience, strengths, and interests, alongside our current hiring needs, to determine which area would be the best fit for you and where you could have the greatest impact. We’ll share this with you before the final stage of the process.

 - Claims Management: We refund €350M+ in healthcare expenses every year to 1M+ members across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. Our mission is to pay each member the right amount, as quickly as possible, while staying cost-effective for Alan. We have built the entire claims chain in-house, from LLM-powered parsing of 2.5M documents per year https://medium.com/alan/how-we-reached-70-document-processing-automation-at-alan-674bc80f3ef3 and a global coverage engine that determines how much each member should receive, to payment infrastructure, fraud prevention https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/chaque-euro-fraud%C3%A9-%C3%A0-lassurance-sant%C3%A9-cest-un-de-moins-martos-ssxae/, and the member experience across mobile and web https://medium.com/alan/universalisation-at-alan-how-we-stopped-building-everything-twice-7feb8d88a4a8. You’ll work on deep systems that must be reliable 24/7 and operate at scale, where every improvement has a direct impact on a member’s bank account.

 - Insurance Offer: We build the infrastructure that protects 1M+ people across four countries. Our mission is to make insurance simpler, more scalable, and more effective for our members and customers. You’ll work on real-time pricing, AI-powered tools that empower Sales, and Alan’s next-generation global insurance stack. More information here https://medium.com/alan/how-we-refactored-one-of-our-most-used-data-models-33cadaf31313 and here https://medium.com/alan/one-stack-for-every-country-and-product-inside-alans-core-stack-e87a127efa12.

 - Customer Enablement: We run the engine behind every company that joins Alan. We bill 40K+ companies across four countries, affiliate their employees, and keep payroll and employment data accurate for 1M+ members. Our mission is to build the shared infrastructure that enables other Alan services to operate reliably and efficiently. You’ll work on a multi-country billing and invoicing platform, affiliation and employment systems that determine who is covered and from when, reconciliation tooling that identifies coverage and billing mismatches, and the APIs used by other teams to build their services. These are systems where correctness is non-negotiable: a wrong invoice or a missed affiliation can be visible to a company within the same week.




 ⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for engineers with 3+ years of experience to help us scale our Engineering community from different perspectives (product, tech, and internal organization-wise):

 - You’ll be able to tackle high-impact & high-risk projects involving many engineers.

 - You’ll design efficient systems and engineering practices to align with and facilitate interactions between multiple teams/products.

 - You’ll have the opportunity to mentor other engineers & lead crews (more details in this article https://blog.alan.com/tech-et-produit/engineering-organisation-at-alan).

 - You’ll be able to contribute to hiring your future coworkers and shape candidates’ hiring experience (improving our technical assessment process etc...)

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you: 

 - Well-versed in Object Oriented Programming such as Python, Java, C#, and enthusiastic about web technologies such as modern Javascript.

 - Willing to work in Python/JavaScript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).

 - Passionate about building products.

 - Self-starting and entrepreneurial.

 - Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).

 - Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching.

 - Fluent in English (no need to speak French!).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C-F level range.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

If you identify as a woman and do not meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you. Research suggests that women can be more selective than men when deciding whether to apply, so please do not self-select out.




🙌 PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Fair rewards & equity packages.

 - Flexible office & remote options.

 - Top-tier equipment: MacBook Pro, monitor, noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation & hours.

 - Comprehensive healthcare for you, children, and partners.

 - Transport support and coaching for personal growth.

 - Training budget for conferences, courses, books.

 - Extended parental leave for all parents.
   
    


🔄 RECRUITMENT NOTE

🌟 We hire people, not roles. Don’t worry if you don’t check every box - high potential and curiosity matter most. We may even suggest another team if we see a better fit.

To see all our opened Engineering positions, click here https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/alan?departmentId=8ba0fb44-ec79-4731-bf45-d65a821e24f0 !

 

🔖 Learn more About Alan https://alan.com/about and on our Career https://alan.com/careers pages, Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm.



🔄 A quick note about the process
Note: While you're applying for a specific area,, you may join a different engineering team based on where we think you'll have the most impact. Check out descriptions of other areas here https://www.notion.so/alaninsurance/Software-Engineering-Areas-Alan-2c61426e8be7805bacd2cdbc08c32640?source=copy_link.

title: Business Developer Germany - New Business Germany 🇩🇪 (m/w/d)
description:
[UNSERE MISSION UND UNSERE KUND:INNEN]
Wir schaffen die Freiheit für KMU, erfolgreich zu sein: mit Europas führendem Finanz-Workspace, in dessen Kern das Banking steht, ergänzt durch Finanztools. Wir sind stolz auf unsere Bewertung von 4,7 auf Trustpilot, basierend auf 60.000 Bewertungen. In unserer Kultur steht die Zufriedenheit der Kund:innen im Mittelpunkt (mehr zu unserer Kultur hier).

[UNSERE GESCHICHTE]
Qonto wurde 2016 gegründet und 2017 von Alexandre und Steve gestartet. Heute zählen wir 1.700 Qontoers, die über 750.000 Kund:innen in 8 europäischen Ländern betreuen. Seit 2023 sind wir profitabel, und wir fangen gerade erst an.

[UNSERE ÜBERZEUGUNGEN]
Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten und Potenzial ein. Mit über 80 Nationalitäten, 45 % Frauen und 56 % Frauen in unserem Leadership-Team ist Diversität für uns kein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Wir haben einen diskriminierungsfreien Einstellungsprozess aufgebaut, weil die besten Teams auf Leistung beruhen.

[KI BEI QONTO]
KI ist tief in unsere Arbeitsweise verankert (hier). Alle Qontoers erhalten unbegrenzten Zugang zu den besten KI-Tools. Wir suchen Menschen, die ausprobieren, ohne auf Erlaubnis zu warten, KI über das Offensichtliche hinaus einsetzen und wissen, wann sie ihr vertrauen und wann sie sie hinterfragen sollten.



Werde Business Developer - New Business Germany bei uns und hilf Freelancer:innen und kleinen Unternehmen, das passende Qonto-Produkt zu finden und Kund:innen zu werden. Du rufst eingehende Leads auf Deutsch an, beginnst mit den dringendsten und führst sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zum eröffneten Konto. Du arbeitest in unserem neuen Büro in Barcelona, nahe der Plaça de Catalunya, gemeinsam mit den Sales-Teams aus Frankreich, Italien, Spanien und Deutschland.

Du berichtest an Clément Chanut https://www.linkedin.com/in/cl%C3%A9ment-c-518671114/, unseren Head of Inside Sales Western Europe.

➡️ Was du bei uns tust

 - Ruf Freelancer:innen und kleine Unternehmen an, die Interesse an Qonto gezeigt haben: Du meldest dich bei jedem neuen Lead innerhalb von 5 Minuten und priorisierst die dringenden Anrufe.

 - Verstehe, was sie brauchen: Du stellst die richtigen Fragen, hörst zu und empfiehlst den Qonto-Plan, der zu ihrer Situation passt.

 - Mach aus Gesprächen eröffnete Konten: Du begleitest jede Interessent:in bis zur Kontoeröffnung und baust eine langfristige Beziehung auf, nicht nur einen einmaligen Abschluss.

 - Gib weiter, was du hörst: Du bringst Kundenfeedback zu den Produkt- und Sales-Teams, damit wir besser mit Solopreneur:innen sprechen.

➡️ Was du mitbringst

 - Sicherheit am Telefon: Du stellst dich klar vor und hältst das Gespräch am Laufen, auch bei vielen Anrufen am Tag.

 - Neugier und Zuhören: Du startest bei der Situation der Kund:in, bevor du ein Produkt vorschlägst.

 - Offenheit für Feedback: Du holst dir Feedback und setzt es direkt um.

 - KI-Fitness: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, um Zeit zu sparen und bessere Ergebnisse zu liefern.

 - Deutsch und Englisch: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch für deine Anrufe und Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unserem internationalen Team.

➡️ Das bieten wir dir

 - Ein strukturierter Start: Ein schrittweises Ramp-up in den ersten drei Monaten, mit Zielen, die Monat für Monat wachsen.

 - Monatliche variable Vergütung: Sie beginnt ab 50 % der Zielerreichung und zahlt ab 100 % das Doppelte.

 - Tägliche Praxis mit echten Kund:innen: Du sprichst mit Freelancer:innen und kleinen Unternehmen und baust deine Gesprächs- und Discovery-Skills auf, während du die Qonto-Produkte kennenlernst.

 - Ein Hub für vier Märkte in Barcelona: Die Sales-Teams aus Frankreich, Italien, Spanien und Deutschland sitzen im selben Büro, du siehst also, was in welchem Markt funktioniert.

➡️ Deine zukünftige Führungskraft

Deine Führungskraft ist Clément Chanut https://www.linkedin.com/in/cl%C3%A9mentc-518671114, unser Head of Inside Sales Western Europe.

Sein Werdegang? Clément hat im Vertrieb und als Account Manager angefangen und ist über Sales Enablement und SDR-Management in die Vertriebsführung gewachsen. Seit er 2024 zu Qonto kam, hat er das französische Sales-Team von 3 auf über 20 Personen ausgebaut und den Sales-Prozess dahinter aufgebaut.

Was bringt er ins Team mit? Clément stellt sich auf jede Person ein und nimmt sich Zeit, dein Profil zu verstehen. Er arbeitet sehr datengetrieben und wertet deine Zahlen aus, um deine Performance zu verstehen. Er ist kollaborativ und arbeitet mit einem "Vertrag", in dem sich alle füreinander verpflichten.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.



[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here https://qonto.com/en/careers/candidate-journey



[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice https://qonto.com/en/legal-documents/privacy-notice for full details.



🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Qonto will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it to support@qonto.com.

title: Conversational AI Consultant
description:
We are seeking a visionary Generative- and Conversational AI Consultant to drive the next evolution of enterprise customer service. In this role, you will act as the strategic bridge between our clients' business needs and our cutting-edge AI capabilities. You will paint the "target picture" for large-scale service transformations, rapidly build MVPs and mini-POCs, and seamlessly orchestrate our in-house Conversational AI Platform with leading industry engines.
Crucially, you will act as a proactive technology scout —identifying development potentials for our platform, collaborate with our customers, screening the market for best-in-breed solutions (e.g., advanced VoiceAI, STT/TTS engines, Multimodal models), and integrating these innovations to continuously future-proof our ecosystem.
• Vision & Target Pictures: Design visionary Target Operating Models for enterprise clients, illustrating how human experts and AI (Voice, Chat, Agent Assist) seamlessly collaborate in a unified service flow.
• Rapid Prototyping & MVPs: Hands-on design and development of conversational flows, dynamic demos, and mini-POCs to validate complex use cases and drive stakeholder buy-in early in the sales cycle.
• Strategic Tech Scouting & Gap Mitigation: Continuously screen the AI market for disruptive technologies and products. Identify capability gaps within our current platform based on customer feedback, and evaluate third-party tools (e.g., ElevenLabs, Soniox, specialized LLMs) to strategically compensate for these weaknesses.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, and Developers to ensure that your MVPs and scouted technologies are feasible, scalable, and effectively integrated into our abstracted "Hub" architecture.
Consultative Leadership & Transformation Enablement: Provide expert consultative support during pre-sales, discovery, and early delivery phases. Act as a trusted advisor to internal Bosch stakeholders and external clients, actively sharing best practices and enabling the broader organization to successfully navigate the AI transformation process
• Language: Fluent in English and German (Level: min. B2-C1).
• Education: Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent professional experience.
• Experience: Proven track record in Conversational AI consulting, solution engineering, or technical business analysis, with a deep understanding of customer service processes and contact center KPIs (e.g., AHT, Containment Rate, CSAT).
• Storytelling & Translation: Exceptional communication skills—ability to translate complex AI architectures (the "technology zoo") into clear, compelling value propositions and ROI for Business Owners.
• Tech Fluency: Hands-on experience with at least one leading conversational platform (e.g., Google CCAI / Dialogflow CX, Genesys Cloud CX, Cognigy, or Salesforce) and a strong grasp of GenAI prompt engineering.
• Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive, analytical approach to identifying technical bottlenecks and finding creative market solutions to overcome them.
Nice to Have
• Experience with advanced VoiceAI components (STT/TTS engines like Soniox, ElevenLabs) and low-latency streaming architectures.
• Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and how to orchestrate enterprise knowledge (e.g., CRM, web crawling, Docupedia) for AI consumption.
• Knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and basic scripting (e.g., JavaScript, Python) for rapid API prototyping.
• Previous experience operating in a B2B SaaS, Managed Services, or Enterprise IT environment
Why Join Us
• Shape the Future: Take on real responsibility from day one and actively influence the roadmap of our Conversational AI offerings.
• Work with the Best: Don't get locked into a single vendor. You will orchestrate the absolute best-in-breed technologies (Google, Gemini, Parloa, ElevenLabs) in one unified ecosystem.

title: Solutions Engineer (AI, Identity & Data Security)
description:
About WhiteMatter
WhiteMatter is the first agent-native company that secures and operationalizes the agentic enterprise across the entire agent lifecycle. Foundation models are non-deterministic, so protecting agents only at runtime leaves every decision to the last millisecond and every alert to the security team. WhiteMatter treats AI as a deployment problem first: every agent is assessed, governed against policy, and deployed from an approved blueprint before it reaches production; every action it takes is decided before it executes; and every outcome is proven after it runs. Founded by security veterans and deployed across, WhiteMatter is headquartered in Austin, Texas. Make every agent matter.
Why Join Us
We are building the infrastructure that makes safe, autonomous AI a reality for the enterprise. Joining our team means tackling unsolved engineering and security challenges at the absolute cutting edge of agentic AI. We operate with high velocity, value ownership, and are backed by top-tier investors. If you want to shape how the world's most advanced AI systems are governed and deployed, we want you on board.
## About the Role
The Sales Engineer is the technical authority and narrative driver in customer engagements. This role is responsible for translating complex AI, Identity, and Data Protection challenges into defensible, real-world solutions—while helping customers understand not just how something works, but why it matters. This role blends deep hands-on technical expertise with storytelling, big-picture (“paint the picture”) thinking, and collaborative problem solving. You will work with prospects to obtain the technical win by designing a viable technical solution with an amazing product that can be applied to various scenarios. You will operate across AI security, LLMs, AI agents, MCP, DLP, and Identity, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to close deals and influence product direction.
## Key Responsibilities
## Technical Discovery & Storytelling
• Lead technical discovery for AI security, DLP, and Identity-driven use cases.
• Translate complex security architectures into clear narratives that resonate with:
## ○ CISOs and VP’s
## ○ Security leaders
## ○ Architects
## ○ Engineers
## ○ Business stakeholders
• “Paint the big picture” by connecting AI usage, identity trust, and data protection into a cohesive story.
• Clearly articulate what problems are solvable today, what are partially solvable, and what are structural limitations.
## Architecture & Solution Design
• Design and present end-to-end architectures covering:
○ LLM and AI agent workflows (human + non-human identities)
○ Data protection, inspection, and policy enforcement
○ Identity, authentication, authorization, and trust boundaries
• Build, configure, and run demos and POCs using Dockerized components.
• Integrate enterprise environments including:
## ○ Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta
## ○ Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro
• Explain and demonstrate AI pipelines using:
## ○ LangChain, LangGraph
○ MCP-style agent orchestration patterns
• Lead deep dives into DLP architectures, including:
○ What DLP can realistically detect and enforce
○ Where traditional DLP breaks down (AI, agents, encrypted channels, context loss)
○ Common false assumptions customers have about DLP coverage
• Help customers understand enforcement gaps, bypass scenarios, and risk trade-offs without overselling.
Workshops & Collaborative Problem Solving
• Facilitate technical workshops and brainstorming sessions with customer teams.
• Co-design architectures and controls with customers rather than prescribing static solutions.
## ● Whiteboard flows covering:
## ○ AI access paths
## ○ Identity trust boundaries
## ○ Data movement and enforcement points
• Use workshops to uncover real constraints and drive solution alignment.
## Execution & Field Innovation
• Troubleshoot complex issues across AI pipelines, identity flows, and data paths.
• Create interim or custom solutions using Python, YAML, and cloud services when product features are missing.
• Collaborate with Product and Engineering to validate feasibility and relay field feedback.
• Maintain technical assets, demo configurations, and documentation in GitHub.
## Required Skills & Experience
• Deep, practical understanding of Data Loss Prevention (DLP):
○ Inspection, classification, enforcement points
○ Real-world limitations and bypass scenarios
## ● Strong hands-on knowledge of:
## ○ AI systems, LLMs, AI agents
○ Emerging AI security risks and abuse patterns
• Solid foundation in Identity & Access Management (IAM):
○ SSO, OAuth/OIDC, tokens, policy enforcement
## ● Practical experience with:
## ○ Docker
## ○ Linux
## ○ Python
## ○ YAML-based configuration
• Familiarity with endpoint and device trust tooling:
## ○ Microsoft Intune
## ○ Jamf Pro
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
• Comfortable using GitHub for code, configs, and version control.
• Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive-level presentation skills.
• Ability to lead workshops, whiteboard complex systems, and drive collaborative design sessions.
• Experience in an early startup environment preferred
## What Success Looks Like
• Customers trust you not just as a technologist, but as a strategic advisor.
• Complex AI, identity, and DLP concepts are understood clearly at every stakeholder level.
• POCs reflect real customer constraints, not idealized lab conditions.
• Workshops result in alignment, not confusion.
• Deals move forward because solutions are credible, transparent, and defensible—even as the product evolves.
