title: Statistical Programmer I/II/III - FSP
description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.
Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
## About Parexel
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose - moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.
## About the Role
We are seeking a Statistical Programmer to join our team. As a Statistical Programmer, you will support the full lifecycle of clinical trial data - from dataset creation through regulatory submission - helping bring new therapies to patients faster and with greater confidence in data quality.
This position plays a key role in producing and quality-checking the programming deliverables that underpin clinical study results. You will work across multiple studies and drug programs, contributing directly to CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets, as well as the tables, listings, and figures that inform regulatory decisions. You will collaborate closely with lead programmers, biostatisticians, and cross-functional study teams, following established SOPs and industry guidelines.
You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through precise data programming, cross-functional collaboration, and consistent delivery against study timelines. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, Statistical Programmers at Parexel can explore career paths and expand skills across the full breadth of clinical research programming.
## Key Responsibilities
• Perform both production and quality control (QC) programming of SDTM datasets, analysis datasets, tables, listings, and figures (TLFs) across multiple clinical trials using SAS and/or R
• Integrate and reconcile data across multiple studies or drug programs to support portfolio-level reporting and submissions
• Deliver programming work with minimal supervision under the direction of a lead programmer, maintaining high standards of accuracy and compliance with CDISC standards
• Proactively communicate risks to timelines or technical issues to the lead programmer or technical lead, enabling plans to be adjusted before deadlines are impacted
• Manage a moderate to large volume of complex programming tasks simultaneously, including ad-hoc requests, with minimal guidance
• Participate in team meetings and maintain availability during core working hours to support effective collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders
• Apply knowledge of ICH and FDA/EMEA guidelines and drug submission requirements to programming deliverables (Programmer II and III levels)
## Candidate Profile
You will thrive in this role if you bring:
• Strengths in SAS and/or R programming, data integration, and clinical trial dataset development
• Experience working in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO environment with exposure to regulated data standards
• The ability to manage competing priorities, communicate proactively, and collaborate across teams
• A detail-oriented mindset and a strong commitment to data accuracy and quality control
• Comfort working independently with minimal supervision while knowing when to escalate
• Familiarity with CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM) and regulatory submission requirements
## Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Biology, Social Science, or a related scientific discipline
Programmer I: Entry-level candidates with foundational SAS and/or R programming knowledge and exposure to clinical data environments are encouraged to apply
Programmer II: Minimum of 3 years of SAS programming experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, with extensive knowledge of CDISC standards and working knowledge of drug submission requirements and relevant ICH and FDA/EMEA guidelines
Programmer III: Minimum of 5 years of SAS and/or R programming experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, with extensive knowledge of drug submission requirements and relevant ICH and FDA/EMEA guidelines, and deep expertise in CDISC standards
• Strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills
• Demonstrated ability to handle complex tasks and ad-hoc requests with minimal supervision
## Preferred Qualifications
• Experience supporting regulatory submissions (NDA, BLA, or IND packages)
• Familiarity with both SDTM and ADaM implementation guides
• Experience across multiple therapeutic areas or study phases
• Proficiency in both SAS and R programming environments

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. Peraton is seeking an AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI & LLM Applications to support the development, integration, and deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) capabilities within the IRIS platform.
## Location: Remote role;
• U.S. citizenship required.
• Ability to obtain a Secret security clearance.
## In this role, you will:
• Focus on building large language model (LLM) applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and intelligent analytics solutions supporting defense and intelligence missions.
• Have hands-on experience with Python, generative AI frameworks, and cloud-based development environments, along with an interest in delivering secure, reliable AI solutions for mission-critical applications.
• Be responsible for research in simulation of human intelligence processes by machines including learning, reasoning, and self-correction.
• Design advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms to solve critical business challenges.
## What you'll do:
• Develop, test, and integrate AI and machine learning capabilities into the IRIS platform, including large language model (LLM) features, generative AI pipelines, and intelligent analytics modules aligned to customer requirements.
• Contribute to sprint-based development cycles under IRIS Agile and Scrum practices, participating in daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint demos, and Big Room Planning sessions.
• Implement and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, vector database integrations, and semantic search features supporting IRIS decision-support workflows for defense and intelligence customers.
• Build and support evaluation frameworks and quality assurance pipelines to ensure reliable, accurate, and secure AI-generated outputs in mission-critical environments.
• Assist with AI and ML model deployment, monitoring, and performance optimization in cloud environments including AWS GovCloud IL5 and FedRAMP-compliant infrastructure, including CI/CD pipeline integration.
• Collaborate with IRIS Platform and Enablement and ServiceNow/EPMP engineering teams to ensure AI feature compatibility and seamless integration across IRIS modules.
• Document model configurations, prompt engineering techniques, RAG architectures, and AI workflows; maintain technical documentation aligned to IRIS release standards.
• Support Cyber and Intelligence Sector IRAD technical execution under the direction of senior engineers; contribute to prototype development, TRL advancement, and milestone reporting.
• Apply responsible AI principles including bias detection, hallucination mitigation, and human-in-the-loop review workflows to production AI features serving government customers.
• Provide technical support during customer demonstrations, user acceptance testing, and platform on-boarding activities as needed.
## Qualifications
## Minimum Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or a Master's degree with relevant project or research experience.
• An additional 4 years of experience will be considered in lieu of a bachelor's degree.
• Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts, including experience developing or integrating LLM-based solutions (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent) in a professional or academic setting.
• Demonstrated proficiency in Python and experience with at least one AI/ML development framework such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, or equivalent.
• Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques, vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, pgvector, or equivalent), or embedding models.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms — AWS or Microsoft Azure — and deploying or supporting AI/ML models in cloud environments.
• Experience with version control (Git), Agile/Scrum development practices, and collaborative DevSecOps workflows.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to work independently within established guidelines and contribute to team objectives.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce clear technical documentation.
• U.S. citizenship required.
• Ability to obtain a Secret security clearance.

description:
Who we are
Bowery Valuation is one of the leading startups in the emerging world of real estate tech and the only company of its kind in the commercial real estate appraisal space. We are also the first-ever venture capital-backed commercial appraisal firm, having raised over $80MM. Powered by big data, advanced technology, and extensive expertise, Bowery is redefining the entire commercial appraisal space.
Inside Bowery, we’re a people-forward company dedicated to providing a productive and inspiring working culture. We are a collection of hard-working and enthusiastic types focused on building great teams to support great work. We balance our dedication to success with a commitment to gratitude, kindness, and a team-first attitude.
## About the Role
Bowery is in a new phase: rethinking the whole appraisal process with AI at the core. We’re hiring a Software Engineer to join our AI-first engineering team, reporting to our Head of Technology.
As the first truly tech-enabled appraisal firm - having raised over $80mm backed by Goldman Sachs, Capital One, and numerous venture funds - Bowery has a strong foundation to build on: a proprietary appraisal-writing platform, high-quality data, and a team of 100+ appraisers across 17 offices from more than 1,000 clients. We’ve grown over 30% year-over-year and are fully profitable.
Few industries are better suited for AI than appraisal. The work is structured, repetitive, and data-driven, and it pulls from fragmented sources. We want to use AI to turbocharge appraisers, who can spend their time on judgment, comparables, and compliance instead of data entry. The result will be a better product for our clients and a transformation in the industry.
This is a senior engineering role, not a prompt-writing role. We want someone with a strong software engineering foundation who also uses AI tools like Claude Code and Codex to get far more done than they could alone. You’ll make product decisions, own systems end to end, and hold a high bar for how they’re built.
Bowery is a post-Series B company with clear product-market fit and material scale, but with a small engineering team. You get the security and data of a late-stage startup with the impact of a very early one.
## What You’ll Do
• Design, build, and ship features end to end across our appraisal platform and AI-powered workflows, from data extraction and analysis to narrative generation
• Work directly with appraisers and Ops to understand the problem, decide what to build, and make the product calls to get it shipped
• Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) every day, and help shape how the team uses them well, including knowing where not to trust them
• Build LLM-backed features with evaluation, testing, and monitoring in place so quality is measured, not guessed at
• Own infrastructure and deployments on AWS, including CI/CD with GitHub Actions, infrastructure as code with Terraform, and containerized services with Docker
• Keep the bar high on system design, code review, testing, and observability as we move faster
## Experience and Skills
• 4+ years building and shipping production software, ideally including time at an early-stage or fast-moving company
• Strong fundamentals in system design, data modeling, APIs, and testing
• Fluent in TypeScript and Node.js; React experience is a plus
• AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) are a real part of how you work today, and you have opinions on how to use them without giving up quality
• Experience building with LLMs: prompt design, RAG, structured outputs, and evals
• Experience with AWS preferred, along with GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Docker
## Why You’d Be a Good Fit
You want ownership. You’d rather figure out what should be built than wait for a fully specced ticket, and you’re comfortable making and defending product decisions.
You think critically. You use AI to multiply your output, and you review its work the way you’d review a teammate’s. You know when something is good enough to ship and when it isn’t.
You care how things are built. Speed matters, but so do clean interfaces, tests, and systems that the next engineer can understand.
You enjoy having direct access to end users. Our core users (appraisers and Ops teams) are all in-house, so you’d be iterating with a tight feedback loop. Many of them work 3x/week from our office in Cooper Square.
You value a remote-first eng culture. Our engineers prioritize async communication and make space for deep focus time to help us ship faster.
## Why You Might Not Be a Good Fit
You want well-defined tickets and a narrow scope. This role means wearing many hats and working through ambiguity with the business.
You’d rather not use AI tools in your work. They’re central to how our team operates and how we expect to scale.
You’d ship code you don’t understand. AI-generated code still needs to meet our engineering standards, and you own what you merge.
## Bowery’s Tech Stack
Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript
Frontend: React
Backend: Node.js (NestJS framework)
Database: MongoDB, Postgres
Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions

• Madeline Pinkner, Head of Technology; LinkedIn
• Eliot Jenkins, President and Chief Operating Officer; LinkedIn
• Steve Schaller, Chief Revenue Officer; LinkedIn

description:
## Job Description
EverHealth AI Analyst
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications.
## Responsibilities
## Build AI Products & Automation
• Build automations and AI agents from early prototype to something a team runs every day.
• Apply AI models where they improve speed, accuracy, or quality, and test their output against real data until quality is consistent.
• Write, test, and version the prompts that production workflows depend on.
• Flag where a model is unreliable for a task and recommend a different approach instead of forcing it.
## Connect Systems
• Connect the systems a team depends on so data and actions move automatically instead of by hand.
• Build connections that hold up in production: authentication, error handling, and edge cases, not just the happy path.
• Partner with our platform engineer on anything that should become part of shared infrastructure rather than a one off connection.
## Maintain Agents & Products
• Own what you build once it is live. Monitor runs, catch problems early, and fix them quickly when an upstream system or a data change breaks something.
• Keep credentials, connections, and access organized and secure, following team governance practices.
• Track how automations and agents perform, and look for ways to make them more reliable or extend them.
## Discover & Analyze Processes
• Sit with teams to map how a process works today, step by step, and identify the manual, repetitive, or error prone parts.
• Recommend which processes are good automation candidates and which need to be fixed first, since automating a broken process only makes it break faster.
• Gather the inputs, systems, and rules an automation needs before the build starts.
## Partner, Document & Hand Off
• Work with function leaders and their teams to gather requirements and confirm that what you built does what they actually need.
• Partner with the platform engineer and forward deployed engineers on larger builds, owning the pieces suited to your level.
• Document every automation: what it does, what it touches, who owns it, and how to troubleshoot it. Hand it off with clear instructions so the owning team can run it day to day.
• Help shape how this team works as it grows, from build standards to how we engage a function, since you are one of the first people on it.
Skills and Experience Needed for Success in This Role
• 2+ years in automation, operations, revenue operations, analytics, IT, or a related role where you built or maintained workflows or tooling.
• Hands on experience with a no code or low code automation tool such as Zapier, n8n, or Power Automate.
• Comfort working with APIs and JSON and reading or lightly editing code. You do not need to be a software engineer, but a webhook or an API doc should not scare you off.
• Exposure to AI tools and prompt writing, plus a clear interest in getting good at it.
• Strong process thinking. You can look at how something is done and see where it breaks or wastes time.
• Careful, organized, and good at documentation. You keep track of what you built and why.
• Clear written communication, since much of the work is explaining a process or a handoff to another team.
• Comfortable working independently in a fast changing environment with shifting priorities.
## Preferred Experience
• Healthcare technology, SaaS, or another highly regulated environment.
• Experience with CRM and other core business systems.
• Direct experience with LLM APIs and prompt engineering for production use.
• Process mapping or continuous improvement methods.
• Building internal dashboards or reporting.
• Experience on a team that was being stood up from scratch.
Where: The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States. Candidates based in the Chicago area will work hybrid, meeting with the team in person 1–2 days per week. Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. will work remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.
## Benefits and Perks:
• Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
• Continued investment in your professional development
• Day 1 access to robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
• 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
• Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
• Employee Stock Purchase Program
Compensation: The target base compensation for this position is $55,000 to $80,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.
EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Job Title: Agentforce Prompt and Conversation Engineer – US
## Cohort: Senior Associate
Role Type: Individual Contributor
The Agentforce Prompt and Conversation Engineer will build, test, and improve AI-powered experiences that support Customer Success. This role will own prompt engineering and conversation design for Salesforce Agentforce and configure solutions in additional platforms as business needs evolve. Working from requirements established by business and product partners, this individual will translate those requirements into reliable, useful agent experiences that improve employee productivity, customer outcomes, and service delivery.
## Position Summary
This role combines hands-on prompt engineering, conversation design, and low-code configuration. Responsibilities span solution design, development, evaluation, release readiness, monitoring, and ongoing improvement. The role will maintain assigned prompts, conversation flows, and agent configurations, ensuring that they support defined business objectives and work effectively within Customer Success workflows.
The successful candidate brings practical Agentforce experience, strong writing and analytical skills, and the ability to translate approved requirements into clear, effective interactions. They will work with business, product, platform, and technical partners to resolve implementation questions, manage dependencies, and improve solution quality. As additional platforms are selected, they will learn and apply those tools to address business requirements, primarily through low-code configuration.
## Responsibilities
## Prompt Engineering and Conversation Design
• Design, build, and maintain prompts and conversation flows for Agentforce solutions supporting Customer Success.
• Translate approved business requirements into agent instructions, conversational paths, and low-code configurations with clear acceptance criteria.
• Define how agents respond to ambiguous requests, seek clarification, maintain relevant context, and hand off to employees when needed.
• Refine prompts and responses for clarity, accuracy, consistency, tone, and usefulness within the intended workflow.
• Configure how agents use approved knowledge and available actions, partnering with platform and technical teams on access and integration dependencies.
• Maintain reusable prompt patterns, conversation components, and documentation that support consistent implementation and efficient maintenance.
## Solution Delivery and Platform Configuration
• Build and configure assigned Agentforce capabilities, coordinating with Salesforce administrators and technical partners on supporting platform changes.
• Configure solutions in additional approved toolsets as they are introduced, selecting implementation approaches that fit business requirements and platform capabilities.
• Identify gaps or ambiguities in approved requirements and work with the responsible business or product owner to resolve them.
• Manage assigned implementation tasks, defects, and enhancements; communicate progress, dependencies, and delivery risks.
• Prepare solutions for testing and release, coordinate deployment through established change controls, and provide documentation and guidance for operational use.
• Engage engineering partners when requirements exceed low-code capabilities or require custom development and integrations.
## Evaluation and Continuous Improvement
• Develop and maintain test scenarios covering expected interactions, ambiguous requests, edge cases, and unsuccessful outcomes.
• Evaluate prompt and conversation performance against agreed criteria, including response accuracy, relevance, task completion, appropriate escalation, and user experience.
• Test changes before release and use repeatable evaluations to identify regressions.
• Monitor deployed agent experiences, investigate unsuccessful interactions, and refine prompts, flows, and configurations using evidence and user feedback.
• Partner with business and product teams to assess adoption, employee productivity, service quality, and other agreed measures of business impact.
• Apply established security, privacy, data access, and AI governance requirements throughout development and ongoing maintenance.
## Typical Qualifications
• Hands-on experience building, configuring, testing, and improving solutions using Salesforce Agentforce.
• Practical experience in prompt engineering and conversation design for AI agents or conversational applications.
• Experience using Salesforce low-code configuration capabilities to support business workflows.
• Ability to translate defined business requirements into maintainable agent configurations, conversation flows, and test scenarios.
• Understanding of generative AI behavior and limitations, including inaccurate responses, inconsistent outputs, and the need for appropriate human review.
• Experience evaluating AI-generated responses and systematically improving prompts and conversations based on test results.
• Strong writing and editing skills, with attention to clarity, tone, interaction design, and user needs.
• Ability to troubleshoot issues across prompts, knowledge sources, configurations, and workflow dependencies, engaging technical partners when needed.
• Experience supporting releases, documenting changes, and improving solutions after deployment.
• Ability to learn new platforms and apply low-code tools to evolving business needs.
• Strong collaboration, organization, and communication skills, with the ability to manage assigned work independently and escalate issues appropriately.
• Familiarity with Customer Success workflows, such as onboarding, adoption, customer engagement, and retention, preferred.
• Experience working within enterprise security, privacy, and change-management processes preferred.
Expected Compensation
$119,000 - $203,000

description:
Peraton Overview
Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.
## Responsibilities
Peraton is seeking a Cloud Engineer specializing in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) to help modernize how it manages audit, risk, and compliance. This person will help move from manual evidence collection to a cloud-engineered, continuously monitored program. This senior role owns the transformation end-to-end: the audit and assessment calendar, System Security Plan and control documentation, continuity and privacy deliverables, and compliance reporting, all rebuilt on automated pipelines this role designs and builds directly.
Work Location: Remote
Shift Schedule: 8am – 5pm Eastern Standard Time (EST)
## What you will do:
## Audit & Assessment Leadership
• Own the organization's full audit and assessment calendar, ongoing/continuous control assessments, financial and IT-financial audits, internal controls testing, and security compliance audits (e.g., SOC 1 Type II). Serving as the primary point of contact for external auditors and assessors.
• Lead recurring meetings and working sessions with the client, auditors, and assessors across the audit lifecycle: kickoffs, evidence walkthroughs, interviews, findings reviews, and status updates. Represents the organization’s control environment directly to external stakeholders.
• Provide audit support across the full assessment portfolio, including penetration testing, red/purple/white team exercises, and periodic CISA high-value-asset assessments, incorporating all findings into the risk register and remediation lifecycle.
• Support new system authorization (ATO) and periodic reauthorization efforts, coordinating required documentation and evidence on a recurring cycle.
## Security Documentation & Control Ownership
• Own ongoing maintenance of the System Security Plan (SSP): control implementation updates, system and technical descriptions, and review of inherited/tailored controls against the NIST 800-53 baseline. Validating control descriptions against the actual cloud architecture and configuration, not just the paper record.
• Lead the annual review and executive sign-off cycle for core security documentation and review the organization's control catalog for accuracy against how the environment is built and configured.
## Continuity & Resilience Planning
• Own the annual review, update, and test cycle for business continuity and resilience documentation: business impact analysis, contingency plans, disaster recovery plans, and incident response plans. Grounded in the actual failover, backup, and recovery architecture of the cloud environment, not generic templates.
## Privacy
• Lead recurring privacy impact/threshold assessments in coordination with the privacy function, including technical review of how architecture handles the data in scope.
## Metrics, Reporting & Automation
• Own recurring compliance reporting deliverables: inventory reports, compliance scorecards, SLA and audit-performance metrics, progress reports, and build the automation that generates them directly from the cloud environment (native services, APIs, infrastructure-as-code state) rather than manual collection.
• Design, build, and maintain automated evidence-collection and continuous-monitoring pipelines using native cloud services and scripting/IaC, reducing manual, screenshot-based collection across the full audit and reporting calendar above.
• Identify the highest-value recurring manual processes across audit, documentation, and reporting work, and personally build the automation to address them. This role is expected to build, not just spec and hand off.
## Governance & Stakeholder Coordination
• Maintain governance documents that codify the organization's security and audit-support processes.
• Serve as the point of contact for ad hoc security and privacy inquiries and impact-analysis requests from system and business owners.
• Lead recurring coordination meetings with system owners, risk management, and compliance stakeholders to maintain shared visibility into audit status, findings, and remediation.
## Skills:
• Infrastructure depth. Hands-on experience with the organization's full technical environment: cloud (AWS), networking, databases, and midrange software (OS, VDI, Security, and administrative tool stack. Focus is to build in and extract evidence.
• Infrastructure as Code. Able to read, write, and modify IaC (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) to validate infrastructure configurations, and to build policy as code compliance checks into the pipeline.
• Automation & scripting. Builds working automation (in any language — Python, Bash, PowerShell) for evidence collection, inventory reporting, and continuous monitoring; this is a hands-on build responsibility across this role's full reporting and audit workload, not an occasional task.
• Security tooling & automation. Able to pull compliance-relevant data and build automated evidence collection from the organization’s security tool stack (e.g., SIEM, firewalls, EDR, centralized logging), not limited to cloud-native services. Capable of managing Cloud Native Application Protection Platforms (Wiz, Prisma Cloud) for enterprise “code to runtime” security with automated remediation.
• Networking fundamentals. Understands network architecture, segmentation, and access boundaries to assess whether a control claim about network security is true in the environment. Including cloud platform's native compliance, logging, and monitoring services (e.g., AWS Config, Security Hub, CloudTrail, Audit Manager) as the primary evidence source, replacing manual collection.
• GRC platform fluency. Administers and configure GRC/compliance automation tooling to consume evidence pulled from the cloud environment.
• NIST 800-53 and control framework depth. Experience with control intent (not just control language) to tailor, inherit, and validate controls against real architecture.
• Written and verbal communication. Translates technical implementation into audit-ready narrative for auditors and translates compliance/control requirements into terms that hold up in architecture and code.
• Program and stakeholder management. Runs the full audit, documentation, and reporting calendar, with organizational discipline.
## Qualifications
## Required Qualifications:
• Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
• Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of experience, a Master's Degree and 6 years of experience, an Associate's Degree and 10 years of experience, or a High School diploma or equivalent and 12 years of experience
• 6+ years of combined experience across cloud engineering and GRC/IT audit/information security compliance, with genuine hands-on depth in both
• Demonstrated experience building or maintaining cloud infrastructure and automation (IaC, scripting, cloud-native tooling) in a production environment.
• Experience conducting IRS Publication 1075 compliance reviews and Safeguards Assessments, including evaluating security controls, identifying compliance gaps, and recommending remediation actions.
• Demonstrated experience serving as the primary point of contact between technical teams and external auditors or assessors, and owning security documentation (e.g., SSP) and control implementation.
• Experience managing findings and remediation from audits, penetration testing, or red/white team engagements through to closure.
• A portfolio or concrete example of a manual compliance or reporting process the candidate personally automated is a strong plus. Frameworks: NIST 800-53, NIST CSF, A-123, FISMA, and SOC 1/2 Type 2.
• One or more of the following relevant certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CISSP, CISA, CRISC, or CGRC

description:
## Overview
Lynker, a Federal Government Contractor, is seeking to fill a full-time position supporting the National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) at the Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC). Space Weather refers to variations in the space environment between the sun and Earth that can affect technologies in space and on Earth. Space weather is primarily driven by solar storm phenomena that include coronal mass ejections, solar flares, solar particle events and solar wind. These phenomena that are directed toward Earth are potential drivers of space weather events that can disrupt communications, satellite and airline operations, navigation and surveying systems, as well as electric power grids across large geographic regions on Earth. Space weather is a global issue and an understanding of solar storm phenomena is an important component to SWPC’s success at developing accurate space weather forecasts (event onset, location, duration, and magnitude).
The UI/UX Scientific Application Developer - level I supports SWPC by implementing intuitive, accessible, and responsive web interfaces that communicate critical space weather information. This position is an early-career opportunity ideal for individuals who want to contribute to the modernization of SWPC's web presence and Testbed applications. Working closely with the Web and Testbed teams as well as other developers in the Technology Division, the developer will translate scientific and operational requirements into clean, user-centered designs, and support front-end implementation using contemporary web technologies.
## Responsibilities
The work will primarily include the following responsibilities:
• Design user-friendly, responsive interfaces for SWPC’s web applications and product delivery systems.
• Assist in the development of wireframes, mockups, and prototypes based on stakeholder input and usability goals.
• Implement and maintain front-end interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and frontend frameworks.
• Collaborate with developers and scientists to align user experience goals with backend infrastructure and content delivery requirements.
• Conduct basic usability testing and synthesize user feedback into actionable design improvements.
• Support visual design consistency across SWPC Testbed and production environments.
• Assist in integrating UI designs into Drupal or other CMS platforms, maintaining mobile accessibility and Section 508 compliance.
• Document UI workflows, design standards, and reusable components to promote team collaboration and design consistency.
• Monitor web analytics and feedback mechanisms to inform continuous design improvements.
## Qualifications
At least a Master’s degree in atmospheric science, space physics, geophysics, engineering, computer science, graphic design, human-computer interaction, or mathematics from an accredited institution and at least 8 years of experience in related areas.
## Knowledge, Skills, and Requirements:
• Familiarity with front-end development technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive design techniques.
• Experience using design tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch) to build wireframes and UI mockups.
• Ability to work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment and follow guidance from senior developers and team leads.
• Knowledge of accessibility standards, security and usability principles for public-facing web content.
• Strong attention to detail, communication, documentation, and task ownership.
## Desired skills:
• Exposure to Drupal or similar CMS platforms, especially in theming or content structuring.

• Interest or coursework in space science, atmospheric physics, or scientific visualization.
• Familiarity with web API integration and visualizing scientific data in browser-based environments.
• Experience with Git or other version control systems.
• Ability to communicate design intent and usability rationale effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer focused on model distillation to help us build smaller, faster, and more efficient models without sacrificing quality. You’ll work at the intersection of research and production—taking cutting-edge techniques and turning them into systems that scale.
This is a hands-on role with real ownership: you’ll design distillation pipelines, run large-scale experiments, and ship models used in production.
## What You’ll Do
Design and implement knowledge distillation pipelines (teacher–student, self-distillation, multi-teacher, etc.)
Distill large foundation models into smaller, faster, and cheaper models for inference
Run and analyze large-scale training experiments to evaluate quality, latency, and cost tradeoffs
Collaborate with research to translate new distillation ideas into production-ready code
Optimize training and inference performance (memory, throughput, latency)
Contribute to internal tooling, evaluation frameworks, and experiment tracking
(Optional) Contribute back to open-source models, tooling, or research
## What We’re Looking For
Strong background in machine learning or deep learning
Hands-on experience with model distillation (LLMs or other neural networks)
Solid understanding of training dynamics, loss functions, and optimization
Experience with PyTorch (or JAX) and modern ML tooling
Comfort running experiments on multi-GPU or distributed setups
Ability to reason about model quality vs. performance tradeoffs
Pragmatic mindset: you care about shipping, not just papers
## Nice to Have
Experience distilling LLMs or large sequence models
Experience with inference optimization (quantization, pruning, kernels, etc.)
Familiarity with evaluation for language models
Open-source contributions or research publications
Experience in early-stage or fast-moving startups
## Why Join
Work on core model quality and cost efficiency—not side projects
High ownership and direct impact on product and roadmap
Small, senior team with strong research + engineering culture
Competitive compensation + meaningful equity
## Remote-friendly, async-first environment

title: Software Engineer
description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.
Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
## About Parexel
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
## About the Role
We are seeking a clinical technology professional to join our team. As a Veeva Vault Configuration Developer, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in configuring the Veeva Vault solutions that support study startup, trial management, and document management, ensuring each change follows validated, change-controlled processes from development through release.
Responsibilities include implementing and maintaining Vault configurations, performing unit testing, supporting validation activities, and troubleshooting production issues, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence how clinical teams work every day.
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through accurate, well-tested configuration, reliable production support, and clear technical documentation. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Veeva Vault Configuration Developer can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research technology.
## Key Responsibilities
• Implement Veeva Vault configuration changes based on approved requirements and technical designs.
• Configure and maintain Vault objects, fields, relationships, document types, metadata, document and object lifecycles, and workflows.
• Configure and maintain user actions, state-change actions, notifications, roles, permissions, and security settings, as well as reports, dashboards, checklists, and milestones.
• Follow configuration standards and best practices established by senior developers and architects.
• Support configuration activities across CTMS, eTMF, Study Startup, and Site Connect, as applicable.
• Perform unit testing of configuration changes and document the results.
• Support informal testing, SIT, UAT, and validation activities.
• Fix configuration defects identified during testing.
• Maintain configuration and technical documentation.
• Support the investigation of Veeva production incidents and user issues.
• Troubleshoot basic-to-intermediate issues involving workflows, permissions, document visibility, lifecycle states, notifications, and configuration.
• Perform initial root-cause analysis and escalate complex issues to senior developers or architects.
## You'll thrive in this role if you bring
• Strengths in analyzing existing workflows, lifecycles, objects, and security configurations before making changes, and in troubleshooting configuration issues.
• Strong clinical systems experience or a background in a regulated environment, along with a willingness to develop Veeva expertise.
• The ability to learn quickly and work effectively under guidance from senior developers and technical leads.
• A commitment to quality, with strong attention to detail in testing and documentation.
• Comfort working within configuration, validation, release, and change-control standards.
## Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree in technical discipline (Mathematics, Science, Engineering, Computing, etc.) or a related study, or equivalent project-related experience.
• 1 to 3 years of experience in application configuration, development, or clinical technology.
• Basic understanding of Vault objects and fields, documents and metadata, lifecycles, workflows, roles and permissions, and reports and dashboards.
• Ability to implement low-to-medium complexity Vault configuration changes with guidance.
• Understanding of software development lifecycle and change management processes, and a basic understanding of GxP, validated systems, and regulated application delivery.
• Familiarity with Azure DevOps or Jira for stories, tasks, and defects.
• Ability to perform unit testing and document results, and to troubleshoot configuration and production issues.
• Good analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
## Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Veeva Vault, or strong clinical systems experience with a willingness to develop Veeva expertise.
• Exposure to Veeva Vault Clinical, particularly CTMS, eTMF, Study Startup, or Site Connect.
• Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or another regulated environment.
We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

Experience with data quality evaluation at scale
## Why Join
Real ownership over a core differentiator of the product
Work on models used globally, not just in English-speaking markets
Small, high-caliber team with deep ML and systems experience
Competitive compensation + meaningful equity at Series A stage

title: DevOps Engineer, Edge and Developer Experience (Remote Eligible in Bulgaria)
description:

By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer II to join the Edge and Developer Experience team. Our team collaboratively operates Smartsheet's high-performance edge proxy platform and drives the adoption of internal engineering tooling. The edge proxy serves as the entry point for all traffic across Smartsheet's commercial and FedRAMP-authorized US Government environments. The team supports the lifecycle of this platform: from maintaining proxy configurations, to provisioning the multi-region AWS EKS infrastructure it runs on, to assisting with observability. Beyond the edge layer, the team also drives the integration of internal developer tooling — from а developer portal (IDP) to standardized CI/CD pipelines — that improves the engineering experience and velocity across the company.
You will work remotely from Bulgaria and report to one of our engineering leaders in Bulgaria.
## You will:
• Contribute to the edge proxy platform: Assist in maintaining, upgrading, and extending a high-performance reverse proxy. This includes writing Go and Python automation, managing container images on hardened Linux bases, and working with CDN and traffic management capabilities.
• Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code: Implement Terraform/Terragrunt modules and live environment configurations for EKS clusters, load balancers, IAM roles, and supporting AWS services.
• Operate Kubernetes clusters: Assist in managing multi-region EKS deployments via GitOps workflows (e.g., FluxCD, ArgoCD) and Helm charts.
• Support CI/CD pipelines: Help design, maintain, and improve shared GitLab CI/CD pipeline templates used across team repositories, embedding DevSecOps guardrails.
• Automate operational toil: Build tooling for tasks such as container image patching, EKS AMI rotation, and automated patching cycles.
• Manage observability: Help provision and maintain Datadog SLOs, monitors, and dashboards; participate in the team's on-call rotation responding to incidents.
• Support Developer Experience initiatives: Assist in the rollout and integration of various platforms to reduce cognitive load for engineering teams.
• Apply AI tools: Leverage AI-based workflows within your domain to improve project execution, infrastructure design, and debugging.
## You Have:
• 2–4 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
• A BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
• Hands-on experience with Terraform for managing cloud infrastructure.
• Experience with Kubernetes operations and AWS services (EKS, VPC, IAM, ECR).
• Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language — Go or Python preferred — for building operational automation.
• Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD preferred).
• Familiarity with container image security practices and GitOps workflows.
• A strong operational mindset with a willingness to participate in on-call rotations and incident response.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Fluency in English is required.
• Familiarity with leveraging AI-based workflows to author or maintain code/infrastructure.
• Legally eligible to work in Bulgaria on an ongoing basis.
## Nice to Have:
• Understanding of reverse proxies, API gateways, or load balancers (NGINX, HAProxy, or equivalent).
• Familiarity with FedRAMP or AWS GovCloud operational constraints.
• Experience managing Datadog resources via infrastructure as code.
• Experience integrating internal developer portals or feature flag management tools.

title: CEO, AI Services - US-Based
description:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
As the CEO of AI Services, you will lead Toptal’s AI Services business which is one of the most innovative divisions of Toptal. Our AI Services combine world-class services in data annotation, forward-deployed engineering, enterprise AI transformation, and an integrated AI software development approach — all aimed at advancing the next generation of AI and intelligence for enterprises. These are just some of the areas that you will own within Toptal’s AI Services business.
Your mindset will be that of an engineer who will work to solve business and operational problems. There will be no problem large or small for you to solve yourself. You will be the chief architect and operator of our AI Services business, constructing frameworks that enhance the operational efficiency and push the limits as to what’s possible for AI Services. You will work to build and lead the full-scale execution of Toptal’s AI Services business—including all AI-related areas such as AI-driven businesses and AI Service offerings.
This role demands a builder’s mindset and a deep sense of ownership. You will create the AI frameworks and strategy, ensure the functions are fully built out and working to perfection, and drive consistent execution across all AI Service areas of Toptal. Acting as the business owner for all AI initiatives across Toptal, both internal and external, you’ll oversee the full AI ecosystem while collaborating closely with Product and Engineering to design and scale the systems that power our AI capabilities and client solutions. Working across a high-caliber leadership group, you will bring strong AI discipline and strategic clarity to deliver world-class client outcomes and sustainable growth.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
· Own the vision, strategy, and execution plan for Toptal’s AI Services, including all AI-driven Service offerings.
· Define the organizational structure and leadership model for the AI Services teams, ensuring the right roles and capabilities are in place.
· Provide hands-on operational leadership, bringing rigor, consistency, and clear accountability to all AI Service lines and functions.
· Translate high-level AI Services strategy and business objectives into detailed operational roadmaps for all areas of responsibility.
· Establish scalable AI Services processes and systems to ensure delivery excellence, efficiency, and client satisfaction at scale.
· Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Legal to execute on strategic priorities and company-wide AI Services initiatives.
· Drive a high-performance culture across all functions and businesses, while ensuring we are tightly aligned to support evolving business needs.
In the first week, expect to:
· Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
· Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
· Deep dive into the AI Services organization to gain clarity on current structures, key initiatives, and challenges.
· Meet key leaders and stakeholders across AI, Product, Engineering, and the Executive team to build foundational relationships and understand cross-functional dependencies.
In the first month, expect to:
· Conduct a comprehensive assessment of AI Services initiatives, including organizational structure, team capabilities, operational processes, and performance metrics.
· Engage with senior leaders and key stakeholders to validate your initial findings and gather input on critical challenges and growth opportunities.
· Begin shaping a strategic operating model and execution framework tailored to the unique needs of Toptal’s AI Services function.
· Develop a clear understanding of client expectations and feedback to align AI Services initiatives with market demands.
In the first three months, expect to:
· Begin executing a detailed operational plan that aligns with Toptal’s strategic objectives for AI Services, emphasizing scalability and efficiency.
· Sponsor and oversee initiatives that improve AI Services delivery consistency, system scalability, and client impact, ensuring cross-functional alignment and sustainable operational excellence.
· Deepen engagement with clients and internal stakeholders to anticipate future AI Services needs and proactively adapt offerings.
In the first six months, expect to:
· Achieve significant growth in AI Services-driven business initiatives and impact across Toptal.
· Drive measurable improvements in operational efficiency, client satisfaction, and delivery scalability across all AI Services.
· Refine and scale AI Services processes and systems that support seamless AI Services delivery, resource management, and cross-functional collaboration.
In the first year, expect to:
· Achieve consistent execution of AI Services strategy through a high-performing, aligned leadership team.
· Have positioned Toptal’s AI Services function as a core driver of competitive advantage through scalable operations, strong client delivery, and sustained business impact.
· Scale the operational infrastructure including technology process, to support anticipated AI Services growth.
· Champion innovation and continuous improvement initiatives that keep Toptal agile and ahead of market trends.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
· Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred.
· 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in scaling complex AI, technology or service organizations and multiple business units, ideally within technology-driven environments.
· Proven track record of successfully leading multi-service or AI-driven initiatives with accountability for P&L, growth, and operational excellence.
· Demonstrated ability to develop and execute scalable AI strategies and operational frameworks that drive efficiency, client satisfaction, and sustainable growth.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
## Who We Are
Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.
We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.
Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.
Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.
## What You'll Do
You'll be tasked with a wide range of projects. Each engineer has a realm they focus on, but we're still small enough that we don't have the luxury of deep specialization. We're looking for technical generalists that aren’t afraid to dive into a new stack or toolchain if the need arises (but JavaScript and Node.js make up the brunt of the existing codebase).
Most of the things we work on are parts of the core product (which is an end-to-end pipeline for building computer vision projects spanning from image ingestion to annotation to training and deployment) but from time to time we're also working on things like integrating marketing and sales tools, fighting fires, automating internal processes, and open source projects.
You'll have a wide degree of freedom to advocate for which projects you think should be highest priority and will contribute to our strategy decisions. If you need a rigid list of tasks spelled out in a multi-month roadmap, this role probably won't be a good fit.
The majority of our codebase is written in JavaScript, our machine learning and image processing pipeline is in Python. We run primarily on Firebase and GCS, with some machine learning infrastructure on AWS. We're increasingly using Docker (both internally and for customer facing products like our edge inference server). A lot of our code runs in the browser (including some Tensorflow JS) but we're also working on building APIs and client libraries in several languages.
You certainly don't need to be experienced in all of these areas; but should be excited to learn new skill sets as you need them. We also hope you'll bring some new knowledge and experiences you can share to help level-up the rest of the team.
We’re especially keen to add some rigor to our processes and build the foundation for rapidly scaling the engineering organization (for example: we currently have limited tests and are not using an opinionated front-end framework -- things that will need to change over the coming months in order to be able to seamlessly expand the team).
Example Projects
Creating a filtering interface so our users can mix and match their images based on metadata like the time of day they were captured, the GPS location, or custom tags they've applied.
Expanding our annotation tool to support new functionality (like polygonal annotations image segmentation).
Integrating the core app with external APIs for things like outsourcing annotation tasks and analyzing deployed model performance.
Streamlining our onboarding flow.
Deeper integrations with our other products like Roboflow Universe and our REST API.
Next-generation model assisted labeling.
Optimizing speed and scalability.
## Who You'll Be Working With
Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.
You will directly be working with our Engineering Lead and a team of Full Stack Engineers.
## Where You'll Work
Roboflow is fully distributed. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!
## When You'll Work
Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.
## What You'll Receive
To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.
💰 The target compensation for this role is $165,000 - $195,000 base.
📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:
$4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers
$350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space
$350/mo AI Tools stipend
$150/mo team lunch stipend
$500/one time home office stipend
Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family
Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision
## Interview Process (6+ hours)
Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We are all motivated to work with an exceptional team and don't currently have in-house recruiters. You will be speaking directly with our team about what it's like to work and thrive at Roboflow. We like to be decisive and work fast, so don't be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a day or two.
Introduction Phase:
[30m] Meet with hiring manager for introduction to assess overall mindset and skillset.
[60m] Technical assessment with a Roboflow engineer.
Build with Roboflow Phase:
You will build a small project with Roboflow to showcase your technical and product skills.
Team Interview Phase:
[45m] Meet with your hiring manager and our CTO to demo your project
Final Interview Stage:
[45m] Meet with Head of Operations for a culture discussion.
[60m / Optional] Meet with CEO.
## Not sure if this is you?
We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role or subscribe to our career newsletter by emailing "Subscribe" to operations@roboflow.com. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.
## Equal Employment Opportunity
At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere—and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Research Engineer - Data Infrastructure
description:
## About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.
We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
## How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.
## What we offer
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
## About the role
We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on the data infrastructure that powers our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the systems that make world-class data possible. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:
Building large-scale data pipelines for collecting, processing, filtering, and transforming datasets used to train state-of-the-art models.
Training models used in our data processing pipelines, such as classifiers, quality filters, and labeling models.
Designing data curation strategies such as deduplication, quality scoring, labeling, and augmentation that measurably improve model performance.
Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers explore and train on massive datasets quickly and reliably.
## Requirements
We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:
Experience building data-intensive systems, ideally in support of machine learning training pipelines.
Strong engineering skills in distributed data processing at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, or custom pipelines over large datasets).
The capacity to autonomously evaluate how data quality, composition, and curation affect model outcomes, and to build the tooling to measure it.
Bonus: Experience building or operating web crawlers.
## Location
This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.
#LI-Remote

description:
## About Us
The financial advisory industry is a $80T market in the US, but has seen little technological innovation compared to the self-service market (Robinhood, Betterment, Wealthfront, SoFi). Client data management is a universally painful and expensive problem for financial advisors. Today, advisors manually collect, update, and utilize client data across the 7-10 software tools that they use to run their business. Data transcription and translation across systems is time-consuming and error-prone, leading to costly inefficiencies and embarrassing client-facing problems. Managing data access control, audit logs, and compliance is a constant challenge, particularly in larger organizations.
We are building the first wealth tech data orchestration company. We sync client data across a financial advisor's tech stack, unlocking the efficiency of a fully-integrated software suite with the choice of tools that best fit their business. We are laser-focused on enabling the best technology experiences for advisors and unlocking the potential of the entire wealth tech software ecosystem. We’re an experienced team of start-up operators with deep roots in both tech and advisory. You can learn more about us on our website.
## Role Details
## Role overview:
We're looking for a fullstack engineer to build features across our platform. You'll own end-to-end delivery of product workflows, working across frontend interfaces and backend services to help financial advisors manage client data seamlessly across their tech stack.
## Where you'll make an impact:
Build and ship features end-to-end, working across React, Node.js and Golang.
Develop user-facing workflows including data collection forms, reporting interfaces, and account management experiences that handle complex financial data.
Implement backend APIs and services that power our data syncing and orchestration capabilities, ensuring reliable data flow across systems.
Write well-tested, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, contributing to the team's technical quality and standards.
Collaborate with Product, Design, and other engineers to break down requirements, identify technical approaches, and deliver solutions efficiently.
Debug and resolve production issues across the stack, ensuring system reliability for our customers.
## Requirements:
4-6 years of fullstack engineering experience with exposure to both frontend and backend development.
Solid fundamentals in web development, including JavaScript/TypeScript, modern frontend frameworks (React preferred), API design, and working with databases.
Comfortable working across the full stack - you may have a preference but can contribute effectively on both frontend and backend work.
Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills - you work effectively with teammates and ask good questions when you need clarity.
Eager to learn and grow your technical skills - you're curious about new technologies and open to feedback.
Self-directed and capable of owning features with minimal oversight, while knowing when to ask for input or guidance.
Bias toward shipping and iteration - you balance getting things done with building things well.
## You'll stand out if you have:
Experience building B2B SaaS products or working in fintech/financial services.
Exposure to building integrations, working with third-party APIs, or data transformation pipelines.
Background at startups where you had to wear multiple hats and ship features independently.
Experience with testing frameworks and writing automated tests for both frontend and backend code.
Interest in using AI tools to improve your development workflow and productivity.
Our tech stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Fastify, Golang, PostgreSQL
## Why Dispatch?
Why work at Dispatch?
We’re a highly experienced team with a track record of successfully building together. We’re well-versed in building for the best tech companies and asset managers.
We’re a well-funded company backed by top-tier investors.

title: Machine Learning Engineer

Your profile
Machine Learning Engineer
Turba Labs · Heidelberg (Germany) or San Francisco Bay Area (USA) · On-site, hybrid or remote · Full-time · Candidates must live in Germany or the USA
A scheduling idea that works in a notebook is a rumor until it survives a client's cluster. Data centers now run mixed clusters of GPU generations, vendors and accelerators, and the software that schedules work on them was mostly built for uniform hardware. Turba Labs is building what replaces it, and it has to work on infrastructure we do not control.
Two products. The Scheduler runs live on our clients' infrastructure and decides which workload runs on which GPU, and when. The Simulator answers a related question before a data center spends a cent: given a planned build-out, what is the best way to use it? You make what we build reliable enough for a data center to depend on.
What you will own
• Research to production. Take a validated idea into the Scheduler: design it, build it, test it, roll it out, monitor it, and own what happens after.
• The ML platform's architecture. The decisions others build on, including when a learned approach earns its operational cost over a simple heuristic.
• Training, evaluation and benchmarking pipelines. Every scheduling policy and performance model reproducible and comparable, so progress is measured, not argued.
• GPU-level reality. Profile and optimize workloads and models on heterogeneous hardware, and feed what you measure back into the Simulator.
• Safe failure. Guardrails, fallbacks and observability, so the system running on infrastructure we do not control degrades gracefully, never dramatically.
• The interfaces. Clear contracts and release plans with the infrastructure and product engineers around you.
Who you are
• You have shipped ML into production and carry the operational weight, not just the model.
• You are strong in Python and PyTorch and practice real software engineering: tests, review, CI, and design that survives the next person.
• You think in trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost and risk, and you can say why you chose what you chose.
• You are comfortable close to the hardware, or hungry to be.
• You write designs and tickets that others can execute without a follow-up call.
We do not screen on years or titles. We screen on the hardest system you have shipped and how deeply you understood it.
A plus
• GPU performance work: profiling, CUDA, inference engines such as vLLM or TensorRT, distributed training.
• Experience with cluster or workload schedulers, Linux systems work and Docker.
• Reinforcement learning, optimization or simulation in a production setting.
• Deploying software into customer-managed or on-premises environments.
Why this
